visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a gray t-shirt stands in a gravel parking lot, speaking directly to the camera with a neutral expression. Behind him is a modern, dark-colored tiny house on wheels and several motorcycles parked nearby. The setting is bright and sunny, with lush green trees and a clear blue sky in the background. (2) The camera pans across the campsite, revealing a white motorcycle in the foreground and the black tiny house. On-screen text overlays appear in white at the bottom. There are simple outdoor camping chairs and a table set up next to the cabin, and a concrete fire pit structure is visible. (3) The man walks toward the black cabin, which has a sleek, industrial-style exterior with a digital keypad lock on the door. Several pairs of shoes and slippers are placed neatly on a wooden step leading up to the entrance. The lighting is bright and natural daylight, highlighting the texture of the gravel and the siding of the house. (4) The camera enters the tiny house, showing a clean, compact interior with wooden paneled walls and ceilings. A television is mounted on the wall next to a set of recycling bins and a small table. Two dark sofas and a chair are arranged in a small living area, with a potted plant adding a touch of greenery. (5) The tour continues into the kitchen area, which features a microwave, refrigerator, and various kitchen supplies on open wooden shelves. A ladder leads to a loft bed area above the kitchen. The space is well-lit with recessed ceiling lights and natural light coming from a large window at the end of the room. (6) A close-up shot focuses on the lower bunk bed, which is neatly made with white linens and sits next to a large window overlooking the green trees outside. The man points to the air conditioning unit mounted high on the wall and the control panels for heating and cooling. (7) The man is seen again in the kitchen area, making a hand gesture while speaking to the camera. His reflection and that of another person can be seen in the refrigerator door. The video ends with a final shot of the cabin's interior as the man concludes his review.
